facts.en: Earned a logistics management diploma at Fictional Coppergale Institute in 2011.
facts.zh: 2011 年在虚构铜风学院获得物流管理文凭。

facts.en: Paid maintenance stores planner at Fictional Firshaft Industries from 2011-08 to 2017-12.
facts.zh: 2011-08 至 2017-12 在虚构冷杉轴工业公司任有薪维护物料计划员。

facts.en: Paid spare-parts planner at Fictional Brackenwind Services from 2018-01 to 2022-03.
facts.zh: 2018-01 至 2022-03 在虚构蕨风服务公司任有薪备件计划员。

facts.en: Paid planning lead at the same employer from 2022-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-04 至 2026-08 在同一雇主任有薪计划负责人。

facts.en: Line-manages 3 planners and reviews weekly priorities for approved maintenance parts requirements.
facts.zh: 直接管理 3 名计划员，并审核获批维护备件需求的每周优先事项。

facts.en: Builds replenishment proposals from stock balances, confirmed work orders and supplier lead-time records.
facts.zh: 依据库存余额、已确认工单及供应商交期记录制定补货建议。

facts.en: Separates serviceable stock, inspection-held parts and purchase orders not yet received in planning reports.
facts.zh: 在计划报告中区分可用库存、检验暂留零件及尚未收货采购订单。

facts.en: Engineers approve technical substitutions; purchasing approves purchase commitments and the maintenance manager authorizes work priorities.
facts.zh: 工程师批准技术替代，采购部门批准采购承诺，维护经理授权工作优先次序。

facts.en: Led a 2025-02 review of spare-part coverage for 6 fictional wind-farm service locations.
facts.zh: 2025-02 牵头审查 6 个虚构风电场服务地点的备件覆盖情况。

facts.en: Personally designed the coverage workbook and reviewed planner exceptions; site technicians confirmed equipment applicability.
facts.zh: 个人设计覆盖情况工作簿并审核计划员提出的异常；现场技术员确认设备适用性。

facts.en: The workbook listed 430 part-location combinations involving 170 distinct part numbers.
facts.zh: 该工作簿列出 430 个零件与地点组合，涉及 170 个不同零件编号。

facts.en: It flagged 26 combinations below the approved target level; the source does not report 26 turbine failures or actual outages.
facts.zh: 工作簿标记 26 个低于获批目标水平的组合；资料未报告 26 起风机故障或实际停机。

facts.en: Uses ERP inventory reports, spreadsheet planning formulas and supplier lead-time summaries.
facts.zh: 使用 ERP 库存报表、电子表格计划公式及供应商交期摘要。

facts.en: Discusses supply constraints with service managers and records which dates remain supplier estimates.
facts.zh: 与服务经理讨论供应限制，并记录哪些日期仍为供应商估计。

facts.en: Completed internal people-management training in 2022-06.
facts.zh: 2022-06 完成内部人员管理培训。

facts.en: Coaches planners on demand evidence and reviews their development goals in quarterly meetings.
facts.zh: 指导计划员核对需求依据，并在季度会议审核其发展目标。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Windleaf Model Club, maintaining a shared supply list for small craft projects.
facts.zh: 在虚构风叶模型社做志愿者，为小型手工项目维护共享物料清单。

facts.en: Built a personal paper windmill display in 2023 for a club open day; it generated no electricity.
facts.zh: 2023 年为社团开放日制作个人纸风车展示装置；该装置不发电。

facts.en: Enjoys designing tile-based strategy games and painting wooden tokens.
facts.zh: 爱好设计板块式策略游戏及给木质标记物上色。

facts.en: Maintains approval references for changes to planning assumptions and handovers for unresolved supply risks.
facts.zh: 维护计划假设变更的审批编号，并为未解决供应风险准备交接。

facts.en: No turbine servicing, electrical isolation or engineering sign-off responsibilities are recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录风机维护、电气隔离或工程签批职责。
